# QuickEnrich

QuickEnrich provides employee and company search, contact discovery, and enrichment APIs for sales and go-to-market workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/quickenrich/.

## Actions

- **Find Employee Email (Billable, Sensitive)** (read-only): Ordinarily look up sensitive employee and email data by LinkedIn URL or a complete name-and-company tuple, without reverifying stored data.
- **Find Employee Phone (Billable, Sensitive)** (read-only): Find sensitive employee phone data by LinkedIn URL or a complete name-and-company tuple.
- **List Company Services (Public, Credit-Free)** (read-only): Return public, documented credit-free company-service values for finder filters, optionally narrowed by an autocomplete query.
- **List Filter Values (Public, Credit-Free)** (read-only): Return the public, documented credit-free exact values accepted by one country-code, industry, employee-range, employee-band alias, or…
- **Look Up Employee by Email (Billable, Sensitive)** (read-only): Reverse-look up sensitive employee and company data from an exact email address.
- **Reveal Contact Details (Billable, Sensitive)** (read-only): BILLABLE AND SENSITIVE.
- **Reverify Employee Email (Billable, Sensitive)**: GTM UNLIMITED, BILLABLE, SENSITIVE, AND POTENTIALLY ~30 SECONDS.
- **Search Companies (Billable)** (read-only): Search companies with typed include/exclude and full-text filters.
- **Search Employee Dataset (Billable, Sensitive)** (read-only): Return exactly one provider page of up to 20 sensitive employee contacts for a company, optionally filtered by title and email availability.
- **Search Masked Contacts (Credit-Free, Sensitive)** (read-only): Search sensitive masked contact identity and company data with include/exclude filters.
